values.value: One thing I want to flag before I go — I noticed wood-soil contact on the south side of the house, near the mulch bed. That's a textbook termite-conducive condition: moisture plus a direct path from soil to wood framing. We don't see active activity yet, which is good — but if you ever wanted to get ahead of it, our Termite Protection plan installs Sentricon bait stations around the perimeter. I can have an inspector come look for free, no commitment. Want me to set that up?
